title: 去学校的一天

explanations.1: The first-person pronoun is needed as the subject of the sentence.
explanations.3: '和' connects the subject '我' with '朋友' (friend).
explanations.4: '一块儿' indicates the action is done together.
explanations.5: '了' marks the completion of the action '下' (get off).
explanations.7: '的' indicates possession between '学校' and '前面'.
explanations.8: '前面' is a positional noun indicating location.
explanations.9: '个' is a general measure word for '商店' (store).
explanations.10: '那' is a demonstrative pronoun pointing to a specific store.
explanations.11: '两' is the number two used with measure word '个'.
explanations.12: '一' is the number one used with measure word '个'.
explanations.13: '十' indicates the amount of money spent.
explanations.15: '哪' is an interrogative pronoun asking for a specific selection.
explanations.16: '几' asks for an unspecified small number.
explanations.17: '不' negates the verb '会' indicating inability.
explanations.18: '也' indicates that the friend also has the ability.
explanations.19: '都' emphasizes that all of us are happy.
explanations.20: '很' is a degree adverb modifying '高兴'.

translation: This morning, I set out from home to go to school. I went with my friend by bus. We got off the bus and then walked into school. There is a store in front of the school. We first went to that store to buy things. That store has a lot of stationery inside. I bought two notebooks and a pen. My friend bought a book. I spent ten yuan. Then we went to the classroom for class. The teacher asked: 'Which characters can you read?' I can read them, but my friend cannot. The teacher also said: 'How many Chinese characters can you write?' I can write some Chinese characters. My friend can also write. We are all very happy. At noon, we ate lunch together. In the afternoon, I went home to do homework. In the evening, I watched TV for a while. Today is really happy.
